name: probe
author: isann
description: faucet prober - asks public nodes a question and records the answer

env.desc: passphrase for the ticket-signing key; the key itself is found by the appointment's bound address in artifacts/keystores/. `isann cred issue -enroll` fills this in — it is the same passphrase that signed the appointment, and `from` is what tells it so without the CLI knowing this key's name
override the keystore search directory (default: the install root's artifacts/keystores)

comma-list of nodes that write the questions, tried in turn: 'this' or a node id / favorite alias, optionally '<node>/<service>'. Use 'none' for arithmetic only (an empty value cannot mean that - it is indistinguishable from unset)
service name for generator entries that do not name one (default llm-api)
comma-list of CLIP validators that judge image probes, same syntax as PROBE_GENERATORS. Empty or 'none' means the image track does not run at all
service name for clip entries that do not name one (default clip-api)
how many nodes (in different /24s) get the same question per round (default 5)

how long a TEXT answer may take, in seconds (default 30), scaled up for larger declared models so a bigger model is not penalised for being one. Pairs with PROBE_IMAGE_DEADLINE_SEC - one knob per track. Supersedes PROBE_RESPONSE_DEADLINE_SEC, which is still read

how many rounds an image shot waits for the node's queue to clear before going out anyway (default 10). Ordering into an empty queue is what makes the measured time mean something, but a node that is busy all day is a node with customers - so the wait ends rather than excluding it. 0 = never wait

path to the shot/question database, relative to the app folder (default probe.db). applyEnvOverrides reads this; it was consumed by the code but undeclared here, so `isann mesh config` could not set it

how long a node gets to draw a picture, in seconds. Pairs with PROBE_TEXT_DEADLINE_SEC - one knob per track. 0 or unset = derived from the node's own reported avg_job_sec (x2, floor 300s, ceiling 900s), which is almost always the right answer: a fixed value made a 4GB card time out on every shot while it drew every picture correctly
'true' to also fire at this node. off by default - a prober signing tickets for its own node is the shape a faucet must not have; useful for a single-node test bench
